lineDialog.description: Only the description is needed. The unit price is usually without VAT.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been archived, or the link is wrong.
detail.cancelDescription: Nothing has been received yet. The purchase is kept as cancelled — the Cancelled status filter lists it — and you can mark it as ordered again later.
detail.warranty: {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} warranty
detail.removeLineDescription: “{line}” is removed from the purchase. The activity log keeps a record of it.
detail.documentsBackupNotice: Files uploaded here are not in lazyit's backup yet: they live on the server's file volume, which the database backup does not cover. Keep your own copy of any invoice, order or delivery note you need to keep.
detail.readDocumentHint: Sends the whole file to your AI provider to draft the purchase. Nothing is saved until you review it.
detail.askAiHint: Opens the AI assistant with a message to read this document and fill in the purchase. Nothing is sent until you send it, and every change comes as a card for you to approve.
detail.askAiMessage: Read the document "{name}" (document id {id}) attached to this purchase and fill in the purchase from it.

merge.title: Merge {name} into another supplier
merge.description: Use this when {name} is a duplicate. Pick the supplier that stays: every purchase of {name} moves to it, the empty details of the supplier that stays are filled from {name} without overwriting anything, and {name} is archived.
merge.targetSearch: Search name, tax ID or contact…
merge.purchases: {count, plural, =0 {No purchases move} one {# purchase moves} other {# purchases move}} to {target}.
merge.archivedPurchases: {count, plural, one {# of them is archived} other {# of them are archived}}.
merge.fillNone: Nothing to fill: no empty detail has a value to take.
merge.archiveNote: {name} is archived, not deleted, and each moved purchase records the merge in its activity.

fromPurchase.none: No purchase is waiting for units
fromPurchase.suggestion: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of this model {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} pending on {purchase} ({supplier}).
fromPurchase.newAssetHelp: Receive it against its purchase line instead: the model, cost, dates and warranty come from the purchase, and the asset is linked to it.

cancelRemaining.title: Cancel remaining units
cancelRemaining.description: Units of “{line}” that will not arrive. {pending, plural, one {# unit is} other {# units are}} still pending.

cancelRemaining.cancelledToast: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} cancelled

link.pickLineDescription: Choose the purchase and the line {count, plural, one {this asset was} other {these # assets were}} bought on.
link.diffDescription: {purchase} · {line}. Values from the purchase reach the assets only where you tick them.
link.searchAssets: Search name, asset tag or serial…
link.noAssetLines: This purchase has no asset lines.
link.previewError: Couldn't compare the assets with the purchase.
link.after: After linking, the line will have {received} of {expected} received.
link.overWarning: The line expects {expected}; linking makes {after}. That is allowed — the line will show as over-received.
link.alreadyHere: {count, plural, one {# asset is} other {# assets are}} already on this line and left out.
link.missing: {count, plural, one {# asset was} other {# assets were}} not found and left out.
link.elsewhereHelp: These are never moved silently. Tick the ones that belong to this line instead.
link.alwaysLinked: The supplier, the purchase and its documents are always linked — nothing to apply. Cost and currency move together.
link.nothingToLink: Nothing to link — every asset is already on this line or on another purchase.
link.summary: {linked, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}} linked · {filled, plural, =0 {nothing filled} one {# value filled} other {# values filled}} · {replaced, plural, =0 {nothing replaced} one {# value replaced} other {# values replaced}}
link.submit: Link {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}}
link.linkedToast: {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}} linked
link.linkedSummary: {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}} linked.
link.noneLinked: No asset was linked — see why below.

reasons.linkedElsewhere: On another purchase — tick “Move here” to move it

link.previewChanged: Some of these assets changed since the comparison was shown. Check it again, then link.

provenance.title: Purchase
provenance.loadError: Couldn't load where this asset was bought.
provenance.differsHelp: This asset's purchase cost (in Details) differs from the price on its purchase. lazyit never corrects it on its own.

provenance.unlinkDescription: Unlink {asset} from {purchase}? Its purchase values stay as they are.

pending.subtitle: Lines still waiting for units, oldest order first.

receiveStock.title: Receive into stock
receiveStock.consumableMissing: This line has no consumable yet. Pick one — it is saved on the line, and the stock goes into it.
receiveStock.consumableRequired: Pick the consumable the units go into.
receiveStock.consumableNoAccess: This line has no consumable yet, and you can't view consumables. Ask someone who can to set it on the line.
receiveStock.consumableSaveError: Couldn't save the consumable on the line
receiveStock.quantityHelp: {pending, plural, =0 {Nothing pending on this line} one {# unit pending} other {# units pending}}. Type what actually arrived.
receiveStock.noteHelp: Visible to anyone who can see this consumable's movements, Viewers included — don't put invoice or supplier details here.
receiveStock.submit: Receive {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
receiveStock.receivedToast: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} received into {name}

lineAssets.none: No live asset is linked to this line.
lineAssets.loadError: Couldn't load the assets of this line.
lineAssets.unlinkDescription: Unlink {asset} from “{line}”? The asset keeps its purchase values; the line counts one unit less.

applyLicense.title: Apply license
applyLicense.description: {purchase} · {line}. Nothing changes on the application until you apply it.
applyLicense.loadError: Couldn't read what applying this line would do.
applyLicense.applicationMissing: This line has no application yet. Choose one: it is saved on the line, then you can apply the seats.
applyLicense.applicationArchived: {name} is archived. Choose another application, or restore it first.
applyLicense.applicationSaveError: Couldn't save the application on the line
applyLicense.seatsHelp: {pending, plural, =0 {Every seat of this line is applied} one {# seat still to apply} other {# seats still to apply}}. Leave it blank to set only the renewal.
applyLicense.renewalHelp: The purchase doesn't say when the license renews. Type it if this purchase renews it.
applyLicense.untrackedWarning: This application doesn't track a seat count yet. Applying starts counting at {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}.
applyLicense.overWarning: The line bought {bought}; this makes {after} applied. That's allowed — the line will show more seats than bought.
applyLicense.nothingToApply: Add seats, a renewal date, or both.
applyLicense.appliedToast: {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} applied to {name}

fromAssets.title: Create a purchase from {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}}
fromAssets.description: For assets bought before you recorded purchases. lazyit makes one line per model and links the assets to it.
fromAssets.currencyHelp: Leave it blank to use the currency the assets' costs already share.
fromAssets.linksOnly: Only the link changes: no cost, date or other field of the assets is touched. Copy purchase values to them later from the purchase, if you want.
fromAssets.createdToast: Purchase created with {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}} linked
fromAssets.nothingLinkable: None of the selected assets can be linked: each is archived or already on a purchase. Nothing was created.
fromAssets.partialDescription: {count, plural, one {# asset was} other {# assets were}} linked. These were left out:

reasons.linkedElsewhere: Already on another purchase — move it from that purchase instead

fromAssets.nothingLinkableSupplier: None of the selected assets can be linked: each is archived or already on a purchase. No purchase was created — but the supplier {name} was, and stays.

extraction.title: Review the document
extraction.documentGone: This document is no longer attached to the purchase.
extraction.readingHelp: Your AI provider is reading it. This can take up to two minutes; nothing is saved meanwhile.
extraction.nothingFilled: Nothing was filled. The document stays attached — enter the purchase by hand, or try again.
extraction.readIntro: lazyit can read this document and propose the purchase's values for you to review.
extraction.readDisclosure: The whole file goes to the AI provider set up in Settings → AI. Nothing is saved until you review the draft and save.

errors.aiDisabled: The AI assistant is off, so documents can't be read.
errors.extractionDisabled: Document extraction is off. An admin can turn it on in Settings → AI.
errors.providerUnsupported: The configured AI provider can't read documents.
errors.notPermitted: You can't read purchase documents with AI: it needs permission to edit purchases and to use the AI assistant.
errors.unsupportedType: The AI provider can't read this type of file. PDF and image files can be read.
errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to be read.
errors.tooManyPages: This document has too many pages to be read.
errors.documentUnavailable: The file of this document is missing on the server.
errors.budget: Your daily AI budget is spent. Try again tomorrow.
errors.unreadable: The AI provider couldn't make sense of this document.
errors.timeout: Reading took too long and was stopped.
errors.providerAuth: The AI provider refused the key configured in Settings → AI.
errors.providerRateLimit: The AI provider is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.providerRefused: The AI provider refused to read this document.
errors.contextLimit: This document is too long for the configured model.
errors.provider: The AI provider couldn't be reached or failed.
errors.unavailable: Reading documents isn't available right now.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to read this document.
errors.notFound: The purchase or the document was not found.
errors.network: Couldn't reach lazyit. Check your connection and try again.
errors.inProgress: You already have a document being read. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many documents were read in the last minute. Try again shortly.

off.providerUnsupported: The configured AI provider can't read documents. An admin can choose another one in Settings → AI.
off.notOffered: Reading documents with AI isn't available to you.
off.documentType: This document can't be read: only PDF and image files up to {max} MB are.

hint.aiDisabled: Documents can be read with AI once the AI assistant is on — <link>Settings → AI</link>.
hint.extractionDisabled: Turn on Document extraction to read these files into the purchase — <link>Settings → AI</link>.
hint.providerUnsupported: The configured AI provider can't read documents — <link>Settings → AI</link>.

preview.label: Document
preview.none: This type of file can't be shown here.
preview.pdfHelp: PDFs open in your browser's own viewer, in a new tab — put it beside this one to compare.

warnings.AMOUNT_AMBIGUOUS: This amount reads two ways (thousands or decimals), so it was left blank. Type it as on the document.
warnings.AMOUNT_UNREADABLE: This amount couldn't be read, so it was left blank.
warnings.AMOUNT_TOO_PRECISE: This amount has more than two decimals, so it was left blank.
warnings.QUANTITY_NOT_WHOLE: The quantity isn't a whole number of units, so it was left blank.
warnings.DATE_AMBIGUOUS: This date could be day/month or month/day, and nothing in the document settles it, so it was left blank. Type it as on the document.
warnings.DATE_UNREADABLE: This date couldn't be read, so it was left blank.
warnings.CURRENCY_AMBIGUOUS: The document only shows a symbol several currencies share. Check the currency.
warnings.LINE_TOTAL_MISMATCH: Quantity × unit price doesn't match the line total the document prints.
warnings.TOTAL_MISMATCH: The lines don't add up to the document's total.
warnings.LINES_TRUNCATED: The document has more lines than one review carries; only the first ones are here. Add the rest by hand.
warnings.generic: Check this value against the document.

extraction.toCheck: {count, plural, one {# to check} other {# to check}}

extraction.quantityNeeded: Type the quantity to add this line.

extraction.modelMatchedMemory: Mapped like an earlier purchase line
extraction.modelSuggested: Suggested from the brand and model — check it
extraction.lineUnchanged: The document agrees with this line.

totals.unknown: The lines can't be checked against the document's total yet.
totals.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# line has} other {# lines have}} no quantity or price

extraction.savedToast: {count, plural, one {# change saved} other {# changes saved}}

newFromDocument.wrongType: {name} can't be read: choose a PDF or an image.
newFromDocument.uploadError: The purchase was created, but the file couldn't be attached.
newFromDocument.renameError: The file is attached, but the purchase's name couldn't be set from it. The review still reads it; its reference shows as a replacement.
newFromDocument.dropTitle: Drop the invoice or quote to start a purchase
newFromDocument.dropDescription: A PDF or an image, up to {max} MB. lazyit creates a draft purchase holding the file and sends the file to your AI provider to read. Nothing read from it is saved until you review it.
newFromDocument.oneAtATime: Only one document is read at a time, so {name} was used.
